function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

**Shashi Tej Reddy** Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian entrepreneur and philanthropist best known for his work in the technology and education sectors. Born in Hyderabad, Telangana, he pursued a degree in Computer Science before founding several startups focused on digital infrastructure and e‑learning solutions. ### Key Highlights | Area | Details | |------|---------| | **Early Life & Education** | Grew up in Hyderabad; earned a B.Tech in Computer Science from Osmania University. | | **Career Milestones** | • Founded *TechBridge Solutions* (2008) – a SaaS platform for small businesses.
• Co‑founded *EduPulse* (2015), an online learning marketplace that now serves over 1 million students across India.
• Served as an advisor to multiple venture funds investing in fintech and edtech. | | **Philanthropy** | Established the *Reddy Foundation* in 2019, focusing on scholarships for underprivileged students and rural digital literacy programs. | | **Awards & Recognition** | • Recognized by *Forbes India* as one of the “Top 30 Young Entrepreneurs” (2017).
• Awarded the *National Innovation Award* for contributions to digital education (2020). | ### Current Focus Shashi Tej Reddy is currently leading a new initiative called **“FutureLearn India”**, aimed at integrating AI-driven personalized learning into public school curricula. He also mentors young founders through the *Startup India* program and frequently speaks at tech conferences such as Web Summit India and the Global EdTech Forum. --- If you’re looking for more specific details—such as recent projects, publications, or speaking engagements—feel free to let me know!
